environment: macOS Darwin 25.6, Python 3.14.7, Node 24; push_guard.py run on scratch copies of skills/sdlc and hooks at 268c8e8 (worktree sdlc/S-005b-v1-security-0); behavior case uses a local bare git remote only; plan-r0 scenarios VS-4 and VS-7

cases.title: A non-constant or opaque form outside a wrapper body changes a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks at 268c8e8. A new function in a wrapper file calls the wrapper with a local list spread, a parameter or f-string verb, a variable program, a non-constant -X value, a parameter api path, a variable -c or -C option, keyword and kwargs forms, a rebound wrapper name, a bytes verb, git.exe, env, sh -c and gh -R pr create.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on each of 50 mutants (SA-01 to SA-50).
cases.then: Each mutant changes at least one pin (opaque, wrapperValues, wrapperVerbs, pushes, direct, forgeViolations or wrapperBodies).
cases.actual: 50 of 50 change a pin. No forwarded-token logic is left to hide a form.
cases.specSource: R-119 scope: "Outside a pinned wrapper body, every non-constant program, verb, option before the verb, or api path is opaque. No token is forwarded."; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e

cases.title: A process, network or dynamic-code form reached by alias, value, attribute chain, import or dynamic code changes a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy at 268c8e8. Mutants use import aliases bound in a function, from-import aliases, shutil.os.system, glob.os.system, branches.subprocess.run, tempfile._os, posix, nt, _posixsubprocess, _socket, _winapi, runpy, code, codeop, modules as values (rebind, default parameter, walrus, list, dict, lambda, decorator, base class), os.__dict__, vars(os), getattr on os, eval, exec, compile, __import__, importlib, globals, locals, vars(), __builtins__, builtins, breakpoint, urllib.request, http.client, socket, ctypes, os.popen, os.posix_spawnp, os.startfile, os.forkpty, pty, asyncio subprocess, shell=True, star import and module-level code.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on each of 70 mutants (SB-01 to SB-65 and SC-07, SC-08).
cases.then: Each mutant changes at least one pin.
cases.specSource: R-119 scope (aliases, values, attribute chains through a watched module, private attributes, dynamic code, native modules); ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e

cases.title: The guard run has no side effect
cases.given: A mutant whose module-level code would run os.system("touch <marker>") and write the marker file.
cases.then: The guard flags the mutant and the marker file does not exist. The cli-runner tree diff of the mutant tree is empty.
cases.actual: marker absent; treeUnchanged true on every scan

evidence.title: marker file after the scan
evidence.inline:
existsSync(MARKER) = false
treeUnchanged = true for all 130 scans

cases.title: The clean tree equals every pin
cases.given: A copy of skills/sdlc and hooks at 268c8e8.
cases.then: No pin differs. opaque and forgeViolations are empty.

evidence.title: clean scan
evidence.inline: clean	NO PIN CHANGED (the log prints this for an empty breach list)

cases.title: A getattr or vars lookup of a watched module through a pure module changes a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy at 268c8e8. janitor.py already imports branches and shutil. branches re-exports subprocess and os. The mutant calls getattr(branches, "subprocess").run(["git", "push", "origin", b]).
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on 7 mutants (SD-01 to SD-07): getattr with a literal name, vars(branches)["subprocess"], getattr(shutil, "os").system, getattr with a variable name, object.__getattribute__, getattr(branches, "os").popen, getattr(hub, "http").client.
cases.then: Each mutant changes a pin, as the attribute chain branches.subprocess.run does.
cases.actual: 0 of 7 change a pin. The getattr check reads only a base that is itself a watched module. A pure module such as branches is not watched. vars(x) with an argument is allowed.
cases.specSource: R-119 scope: "An attribute chain through a watched module, such as shutil.os.system or branches.subprocess.run, is read as the watched module call"; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e: a new form in neither list is covered when it is a process or network call in a scanned file

cases.title: The getattr form pushes a verify branch to a bare remote while every pin is equal
cases.given: The SD-01 mutant of janitor.py with "-C", repo added to the argv, and a local bare remote created by module-loader.
cases.when: Call janitor._verify_sec(repo, "sdlc/S-9-v1-security-0", "s") through module-loader. Run push_guard.py on the same tree.
cases.then: The guard changes a pin or the remote gets no ref.
cases.expected: guard hit or no ref on the remote
cases.actual: The remote gains refs/heads/sdlc/S-9-v1-security-0 and the guard output equals every pin.
cases.specSource: R-119 acceptance: "A verify branch stays local" and a source check that finds no git push; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e

seeds.title: S3: sys.modules lookup reaches any module
seeds.detail: sys.modules["subprocess"].run([... push ...]) leaves every pin equal (SC-04). The plan names sys.modules[...] as seed S3.

seeds.title: S3: subclasses walk
seeds.detail: ().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__() leaves every pin equal (SC-05). Seed S3.

seeds.title: S3: print.__self__ is the builtins module
seeds.detail: print.__self__.__import__("os").system(...) leaves every pin equal (SC-09), because the private-attribute check needs a base name bound to an import. The walk matches seed S3 (attribute walk to a loader), not a literal named form.

seeds.title: S3/S5: a re-exported network class under a pure module name
seeds.detail: hub.ThreadingHTTPServer((...), hub.BaseHTTPRequestHandler) leaves every pin equal (SC-06). It opens a listening socket and is no egress. Recorded only.

seeds.title: Guard design note for the SD forms
seeds.detail: The SD-01 to SD-07 gap has one cause: the getattr and vars checks look at watched bases only. A fix is to treat getattr, setattr, delattr, vars and object.__getattribute__ with an imported-module first argument as dynamic, whatever the module.
